name: Spirax Group plc

corporate_actions.event: Renamed from Spirax-Sarco Engineering plc to Spirax Group plc (not re-verified to month)
H1 2026 results: organic +5%, adj. op margin 19.8%; ETS +11% organic with margin 17.2%

geography.fx_notes: Global: ~110,000 direct customers in 130 countries (PitchBook). Americas, EMEA, APAC roughly balanced; China is a meaningful STS market (INFERENCE ~10% of group; not extracted). EM exposure material (China, India, LatAm) but not quantified this run.

kpis.name: Recurring revenue
kpis.value: ~85% of sales from recurring maintenance and small improvements to existing systems (company/Morningstar description)

lease.source_id: IFRS filer; not extracted this run

acquisitions.notes: Focus on deleveraging after Chromalox (2022, ~GBP0.4bn+) built ETS; no material acquisitions in H1 2026 (acq contribution 0)

management.senior_turnover_5y: CEO change 2023; CFO change(s) since (not verified)
management.guidance_record: Mixed: 2023-2024 downgrades on ETS/semicon and biopharm destocking; 2025-26 restructuring and recovery, FY26 guidance reiterated

guidance.value: Higher H2 volumes; STS margin up in H2; ETS high-single-digit H2 growth, margin slightly ahead of H1; WM high-single-digit H2 growth; FY cash conversion ~90%; capex lower end of 4-5% of sales

evidence: ~85% of sales from maintenance/small improvements to installed steam systems [S2]
A.rationale: Highly recurring installed-base revenue with no concentration.

B.rationale: Engineering service intensity and installed base create strong switching costs.

C.rationale: Scale benefits in STS/WM; ETS integration ongoing.

evidence: Growth tied to industrial production + decarbonisation (electrification) [S1]

G.rationale: Average; ETS returns still below group.

evidence: Semicon is a subset of ETS (~quarter of group) - INFERENCE ~5-8% of group

ai.notes: Semiconductor exposure sits in ETS (Semicon) - double-digit growth in H1 2026; not quantified. INFERENCE: semis ~5-8% of group revenue; AI/DC direct exposure minimal.

sector_specific.notes: ETS 2024-25: weak semicon and low-margin legacy orders depressed ETS growth/margins; 2026 shows recovery (organic +11%, margin 17.2% toward 20% target) - verified via H1 2026 call. Installed-base/aftermarket ~85% of sales. Acquisition contribution nil in H1 2026.

gates.notes: Leverage 1.6x (target 1-1.5x); semis inferred <15%; FY cash conversion ~90% expected (H1 54% seasonal).

bull_points: ~85% recurring installed-base revenue with strong switching costs (S2)
ETS recovery: +11% organic and margin +220bp toward 20% target (S1)
Medium-term margin target 22-23% with operating leverage on higher H2 volumes (S1)
bear_points: STS organic only +1% in H1 2026 and margin down 170bp (S1)
thesis_breakers: Group adjusted operating margin below 18% for a full year
ETS margin failing to reach 18% by 2027
STS organic growth below industrial production for two consecutive years

sources.title: Spirax Group (SPX) H1 2026 results call transcript (Q2 2026)
